title: Reuse drain checks by content and test configuration
summary: Commit IDs and cherry-picks do not invalidate checks when all checked inputs and the test environment are unchanged.
body:
Record a drain check's content fingerprint, command, device/API, pinned server image, exit code, test counts and durable log path. Reuse passing evidence after a cherry-pick or documentation-only commit only when those checked inputs and the test configuration match. Otherwise rerun the affected checks.

The wave 7 investigation demonstrates why commit IDs alone cannot identify duplicate device runs.
